subject: ACME connector: request for trial runway relief and credit uplift
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME connector: request for trial runway relief and credit uplift

Hi Marcus / Monica,

Quick note — ACME's engineering team hit a blocker this morning while wiring up our connector to their ETL. They ran schema changes on their source tables and the connector is failing to reconcile PKs (see attached stacktrace and a short error snippet from their logs).

Diego (ACME) says they need at least two additional weeks to stabilize the adapter and wants a small sandbox credit uplift so their QA team can run load tests once the fix lands. Exact quote from Diego: "If we can't get a little more runway and some extra credits for smoke/load tests we risk delaying our pilot into August — that would push our procurement timeline out."

Asks:
- Can we provision an extra 2 weeks on their trial window?
- Can we grant a $3k sandbox credit (applied to their trial account) to cover CI/load cycles?
- Can we mark this as provisional pending finance sign-off (I'll attach the logs and the integration plan to the HubSpot deal)?

Attachments: acme_error_snippet.txt, connector-stacktrace.log, acme-integration-plan.pdf

I recommend we be generous here: the deal is mid-stage (ACME-4492), strong product fit, and an extension + credit will keep momentum.

Planning to loop in RevOps if you both agree.

Thanks,
Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME connector: request for trial runway relief and credit uplift

Aisha — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the logs. A couple of quick clarifying items before I tag RevOps/Finance: 

1) Do we have an active PO or committed timeline tied to this pilot (I think legal asked for a PO only after sign-off)?
2) Is the requested credit specifically for sandbox token usage or should we split between sandbox and dedicated test instances?

My initial read: ok to approve a provisional $3k credit + a 3-week extension rather than 2 weeks — gives buffer for the fix + smoke testing. If we make it 3 weeks we reduce back-and-forth and that's less friction for procurement.

If Monica is good with provisional approval, I'll prepare a quick memo for RevOps that documents the justification and includes the attachments + HubSpot note. Also recommend we require ACME to confirm acceptance in writing so we can mirror the concession in the deal timeline.

Provisional numbers: credit_amount=$3,000; extension_days=21

--Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME connector: request for trial runway relief and credit uplift

Sounds reasonable — I approve a provisional $3,000 sandbox credit and a 3-week trial extension for ACME (deal ACME-4492). Please follow these conditions:

- Mark the HubSpot deal with the concession and tag RevOps (link: https://hubspot.example/deal/4492).
- Add the attached integration plan to the drive and reference it in the RevOps memo (https://drive.example/redwood/acme-integration-plan).
- Require ACME to reply-all accepting the concession and confirming they will run the proposed QA/load tests.
- Add a telemetry checklist item to the canary so we can track token burn and error rates after we hand them the credits.

I'll escalate to Finance for final sign-off; provisional approval stands until Finance responds, but do proceed with communications to ACME so they can schedule work.

Thanks,
Monica
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Rivera <diego@acme-analytics.com>, PlatformOps <platformops@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ACME connector: request for trial runway relief and credit uplift

Diego — thanks for the quick sync this morning. Looping you back with internal next steps.

Summary / proposal from Redwood:
- Provisional 3-week trial extension (we'll extend your sandbox window by 21 days).
- Provisional $3,000 sandbox credit applied to the trial account for QA / load testing after your engineering fix.
- Finalization: finance needs to sign off; we expect confirmation within 48 hours. This concession is provisional and contingent on your acceptance email (reply-all).

Attached are the logs you shared (connector-stacktrace.log) and our integration plan (acme-integration-plan.pdf). Please reply-all to confirm you'd like to accept these terms and confirm you will run the smoke/load tests once the fix is staged.

If acceptable I'll update the HubSpot deal and put a RevOps ticket in to apply the credit.

Thanks — and sorry for the friction on your side. We want to make sure you can complete the pilot without losing the August window.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Attachments: acme-integration-plan.pdf (plan), connector-stacktrace.log (error dump), acme_error_snippet.txt (short excerpt)

From: Diego Rivera <diego@acme-analytics.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: PlatformOps <platformops@acme-analytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME connector: request for trial runway relief and credit uplift

Aisha / Team — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the provisional offer. ACME confirms: we accept the 3-week extension and the $3,000 sandbox credit. We will run the QA and load tests as described in the integration plan and will reply with test results within 48 hours of staging the fix.

Couple practical notes for Redwood Ops:
- Please apply the credit to the sandbox account id: sandbox-acme-77.
- We'll share the CI job IDs once the smoke tests are scheduled.

Thanks again — this should keep us on track for the August pilot.

Best,
Diego Rivera
Director of Platform Engineering | Acme Analytics
Phone: +1 (617) 555-0199
